Cognios Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 23.66% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cognios Capital Llc bought 7,672 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 40,098 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.73 million, up from 32,426 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cognios Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $942.23 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.76 during the last trading session, reaching $191.7. About 26.66M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending.
